original.target_description: Experiment 2 perceived-certainty manipulation check: main effect of source certainty.

n.location: p. 1039 (PDF p. 7), Participants and Design; p. 1040 ANOVA df
n.quote: Sixty-eight undergraduates participated in person at a behavioral research laboratory for monetary compensation.

replication.target_description: Section 7.1 perceived-certainty manipulation check: main effect of source certainty, direct replication conditions.

notes:
Original full primary paper obtained as HTML transcription; title/authors/DOI verified. Its OCR uses p for equals, ! for less than, and 1 for greater than; quoted OCR is retained verbatim. Replication is the author-hosted full published PDF. Original study 2 and replication section 7.1 are independently matched. Replication analytic N is the sum of printed condition ns, not the overall 1018 sample. No p value inferred from an F bound. Success refers specifically to the manipulation check.
Completion source review (n_r): Final mutually exclusive certainty groups in the direct-replication subset establish participant N; primary analyses retain all participants.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Retained the printed metric and precision for the described test.
